property_summary: Call allowance from a non-authorized address after deny(ward) sets wards[ward]=0 in reference, but after deny(ward) sets wards[msg.sender]=0 in bug, so wards of the caller differ.
change_summary: Replace 'wards[user] = 0;' with 'wards[msg.sender] = 0;' so that the caller is denied instead of the passed address.
